name: Blueberry
note: Team Partner of the BONDS Flying Roos (sailgp.com team page, read 2026-10-02). The brand belongs to Blueberry Markets (claim blueberry-markets-ownership), but that claim names only a managing director (Dean Hyde), not an owner, and no shareholder register was found; Blueberry's own legal page also lists group entities in Mauritius, Vanuatu and the UAE. Without a source naming the owner of Blueberry Markets Pty Ltd, the sponsor stays unrated. Proposed tier: none if a maintainer accepts the ownership evidence.
